rows.independent_semantic_review: Own use-number instruction plus inclusive mathematical interval keeps exact minimum/maximum slots. Actual parser is integer, but this generic error neither promises fractions nor loses an explicit integer requirement from this English source; separate whole-number prompt remains untranslated.

rows.backtranslation: Size: use a number greater than 0.
rows.caller_scope: NormalizeImagesDialog value() must parse finite >0 input. Pixel mode requires numerical whole values; percentage mode permits positive decimals; percentage is relative to the current largest placed dimension of the selected axis. The result rounds into 1..Int.MAX_VALUE. This deliberately generic positive-size prompt retains source specificity rather than incorrectly requiring typed ≥1 or disallowing decimal percentages. No upper size, source cap, RAM fit or successful normalization is promised.
rows.confidence: Moderate source/compositional functional instruction; mathematical notation in prose. No native/layout certificate.
rows.independent_semantic_review: Spatial size + use-number >0 retains generic source condition. Percentage mode allows positive fractions and resolves against largest selected-axis placement; no typed >=1 constraint, integer-only restriction or budget success introduced.

rows.caller_scope: TextStyleDialog text size is parsed by uiNumber, converted to Float and accepted within inclusive 1f..1024f. Decimal keyboard is enabled. Fractions such as 1.5 px are allowed. This is font size, not integer bitmap width/height, memory budget or percentage. Mathematical bounds preserve both endpoints without adding whole/integer.
rows.confidence: Moderate source/compositional functional instruction; mathematical notation in prose. No native/layout certificate.
rows.independent_semantic_review: Inclusive range and px explicitly remain in the error for Float text size. Fractions allowed. Not bitmap dimensions or a memory estimate.

rows.backtranslation: Width and height: use numbers greater than 0. The image you want: width at least 1 pixel and height at least 1 pixel.
rows.caller_scope: DimensionControls first requires finite raw numbers >0, with whole numerical pixel values but decimal percentages allowed; it converts percentages against original per-axis bases, rounds and accepts only 1..Int.MAX_VALUE on each axis. The first clause addresses entered width/height values >0. The second explicitly describes the desired image in px and requires ≥1 separately on width and height, preserving the resolved-output distinction without telling the user to enter ≥1 percent. This is an authored functional paraphrase: it does not introduce an unattested verb for resolve/convert. It neither promises that every positive input works nor claims raw values are already px. Aspect locking may update the opposite field before both are validated; separate consumer memory/source limits remain outside this prompt.
rows.confidence: Moderate source/compositional functional instruction; mathematical notation in prose. No native/layout certificate.
rows.independent_semantic_review: Entered width/height >0 are followed by desired-image width and height each >=1px. Target-image topic plus explicit pixel units distinguishes resolved output from entered percentages. This functional restriction does not assert every positive input is valid, that input already uses pixels, or that consumer memory/source checks pass.

rows.raw: Android ti ha sedi na u ma\'usa i ramienta para un atyik dokumentu: %1$s
rows.display: Android ti ha sedi na u ma'usa i ramienta para un atyik dokumentu: %1$s
rows.linguistic_review: Negated sedi plus a finite irrealis passive means Android did not permit the chooser tool to be used. The two-argument, non-control use of sedi is explicitly supported by Chung. The purpose clause identifies a tool for selecting documents/files rather than a human picker. This preserves a launch block without inventing a permission type, permanent ban, deleted file or failed decoder. The one detail slot is unchanged.
rows.caller_review: Primary calls in ClassicPaintActivity:1101 and AssemblyActivity:195 catch SecurityException. LegacyImageCreditsActivity:120 handles the ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT launch and supplies either error.message or a localized fallback. The nested ACTION_GET_CONTENT fallback is inside the ActivityNotFoundException handler and does not reach its sibling SecurityException catch; v2 metadata correctly limits that claim.

rows.english: The picker returned no file. Please choose the file again.
rows.raw: Tåya\' dokumentu ni marisibi ginin i ramienta para un atyik dokumentu. Put fabot, atyik ta\'lu i dokumentu.
rows.display: Tåya' dokumentu ni marisibi ginin i ramienta para un atyik dokumentu. Put fabot, atyik ta'lu i dokumentu.
rows.linguistic_review: The negative existential is restricted by the received-relative and source phrase, so it says no file was received from the selecting tool, not that no file exists or was deleted. Productive ma-passive is suitable with an unspecified receiving agent. The final polite imperative preserves selection of the file again without promising success or demanding a different file. Singular/default document form is suitable here; it does not assert an exact cardinality of one.
rows.caller_review: ClassicPaintActivity.kt:1251 follows the RESULT_OK gate and tests data?.data ?: data?.clipData?.getItemAt(0)?.uri for null. This precedes the open/import/save/export switch, so the wording must remain generic to a selected file rather than image decoding.

rows.raw: Tåya\' dokumentu siha ni manmarisibi ginin i ramienta para un atyik dokumentu siha.
rows.display: Tåya' dokumentu siha ni manmarisibi ginin i ramienta para un atyik dokumentu siha.
rows.linguistic_review: Plural siha plus the realis plural passive man-ma-risibi is grammatically supported. It preserves no files received from the multi-file selecting tool. It adds no retry instruction and no unsupported-file, cancellation or deletion diagnosis. The existential scopes over the received files rather than making a claim about disk contents.
rows.caller_review: AssemblyActivity.kt:201 tests an empty URI list for ADD_IMAGES and RESULT_OK before importImages. The launcher requests multiple selection; this is not a stream or decode failure.

primary_lexical_sources_actually_read.assessment: Select/choose supports the functional chooser paraphrase; no claim of an attested GUI term.
Document noun. File sense is a disclosed application extension consistent with this catalogue, not a dictionary software attestation.
General tool and receive senses; nearby ramenta hand-tool variant does not invalidate the explicit general tool entry.
Allow/permit fits a blocked chooser launch.

Repetition and negative existence support picker clauses. Decode appears among translåda glosses, but both examples concern language interpretation; that does not resolve the technical-sense ambiguity of this exact candidate.
Picture sense and polite formula supported; running examples use unaccented Put fabot.
Information/message and selected passive supported. No payload-specific sense established by these entries.
Give/provide supports the source-tool purpose phrase, not the image-data constituent by itself.

findings: Realis plural man- and passive intransitivity support manmarisibi; ma-passive singular/dual uses no -um-.
Purpose para plus irrealis un/u is supported. Prepositional para means to/for, which is insufficient to force image payload.
Passive ma- takes a glottal stop before a vowel-initial root in careful speech.
Postnominal ni relative and noun-plural siha are supported.
Affirmative transitive imperative has no agreement prefix.
Sedi has a two-argument non-control use; na plus irrealis complement is supported.

review.fresh_web_check_limit: Focused searches did not establish binary-image decoding usage for translåda. Search absence is not evidence that no such usage exists, and is not the sole basis of the hold. Unrelated Portuguese/Spanish results and machine-written AI pages were not used as authority.

locators: R ramienta line104 and variant ramenta line103
entries.support: Fresh primary entries and examples read. Atyik denotes selection among items. Ramienta is a general tool, not specifically a hand tool in the selected entry. Dokumentu extends the documentary object to an application file, already current for the File menu, file name and file format. The whole phrase ramienta para un atyik dokumentu is an authored software-tool purpose paraphrase for the system file chooser, not an attested dictionary term or a human picker.

locators: sedi line461; non-control two-argument use independently explained by Chung PDF492/printed467 footnote
short_quotes: sedi vt. allow, let, permit, consent.
entries.support: Negated sedi expresses that Android did not allow use of the chooser in this attempt. This is not a statement that the user lacks a particular permission, that a policy is permanent, or that content is unsafe. Na plus an irrealis passive clause supplies the permitted event; there is no invented controller argument.

short_quotes: pinenta n. picture, design, painting, drawing.
entries.support: The primary verb explicitly includes a decoding/interpretation sense. Its illustrative uses concern speech and sign-language interpretation, not binary image decoding. Applying this established verb to Android decoding a picture is an authored digital extension. Android as agent and this picture as object select that operation here; no exact native GUI phrase, software adoption or natural-language translation feature is claimed.

The negative existential plus a passive received-relative expresses zero returned files/data from the named source in this transaction. It does not say the files do not exist on disk, were lost/deleted, or are unsupported. Marisibi is productive ma+risibi, not asserted as a complete attested source word. The multi-picker row explicitly marks file plurality with siha and passive realis plural agreement man-.

locators: put fabót line1248 including unaccented running form
entries.support: The single-picker row preserves both the polite imperative and selecting the file again. Ta’lu is retry/repetition, not choosing a different file and not a claim a retry will succeed. Put fabot follows primary running spelling and is not a requirement to add the interjection to unrelated diagnostics.

locators: infutmasión line398 and unaccented running use imprinta line239
entries.support: Information is used as the payload for producing the picture, not information about the picture such as author or licence metadata. The phrase para i pinenta is a disclosed information-for-picture composition; the phrase put i pinenta, used for metadata in other keys, is deliberately not used. Provider is functionally described as the selected tool for supplying AN Paint pictures; it is neither the file-selection tool nor Android’s decoder. Ni marisibi immediately follows infutmasion, so the relative explicitly modifies the data received, not a supposedly received picture. The software-provider and image-data phrases are new authored paraphrases, not asserted as native technical terminology.

text_pages_actually_read.support: Purpose adjuncts with para and irrealis agreement.
Siña normally combines with realis predicates.
Negative siña can describe a failed past event without future marking.
Optional plural particle siha can follow the head noun.
Null indefinite article can be singular/dual/plural; no assertion of exactly one.
Ma-passive permits an unrealized nonspecific receiver/agent.
Productive ma-passive; glottal stop with vowel-initial root supports ma’usa and ma’atyik.
Direct-object wh-agreement is optional; not needed by the proposed passive received-relative.
Affirmative transitive imperative has no person-number agreement.
Sedi also has a two-argument, non-control use: one who allows plus an event clause.
Finite irrealis complement introduced by na is attested after sedi.
Postnominal relative ni; passive clause can modify a noun.

style_evidence.finding: Adjectives typically precede the described noun. Supports whole + text; does not certify an entire new utterance.

The same noun can be used for one or many; number is often expressed by verbs. This does not authorize mechanically adding a prefix. Control is used here as the bare category label for the UI control collection; no invented plural morphology.
Cherokee verbs have ordered pronominal prefix, stem and tense components. Text inspected directly. No new finite command or completed-copy inflection is derived in this packet.

sense_controls_and_limits: All seven whole strings are authored functional compositions, not quotations of published sentences. Lack of whole-string attestation or native certification is not itself a hold gate.

TBX control4835 is the user-interaction object sense. control821 management-of-processing sense and the ordinary OU control/monopoly entry are not used. The category-label interpretation of the bare noun is explicit; plural morphology is not invented.

The program-editor entry11075/1591057 is used. The alternate entry has a trailing apostrophe and is not silently cleaned or substituted. Parenthesized editor scopes the controls without fabricating a possessive-prefix construction.

View10627 is a verb that causes an application to display information. It supports functional reveal/view wording for Show. Show19508 is retained as an alternative but not used to avoid overreading its object-display scope.

Tool box OU748 is a general lexical toolbox, not an attested software-panel term. Applying it to this grouped tool/command panel is a transparent digital-container metaphor; no claim that the OU dictionary defines software. TBX toolbar is not substituted because it is narrower/different from this whole toolbox panel.

Expand965 explicitly reveals nested entries in a folder or outline; transfer to grouped tab-panel disclosure is an authored functional extension. Collapse4733 expressly hides subordinate material in a section/control, fitting the current caller. Neither label implies artwork scaling.

Full text uses whole797 + ordinary character-data text5203, not a data-field Text type or bitmap image. Copy11991 is an action-label token, not proof of a completed tense. A separately attested done151 status makes completion explicit.

OU retained compilation has limited per-entry dialect/source attribution. All selected entries are unchanged, with exact primary rows and visuals, and are not labeled a silently borrowed regional variety. TBX labels its language chr-Cher and usage USA. No native certification, app-layout QA, or complete-language acceptance is claimed.

Hide347 is transitive hide it imperative, not the neighboring intransitive hide yourself command. The revised row supplies the overt group noun TBX3517 after the scoped controls heading. The exact group sense is a collection of elements treated as a whole, not an artwork-grouping command or an assertion that the program groups drawing objects. It is the singular object of hide; no plural-object inflection is invented. Current caller context remains unavailable for these two dormant editor-control resources.
record.successor_reason: The hide-it imperative has singular object scope. Add overt group noun from exact technical collection-as-whole sense, instead of relying on a bare controls topic to imply a collection.
